staleClaims.claim: Every top-level package has a useful README
staleClaims.currentTruth: Only 16 of 48 top-level package directories have README.md files. 32 package directories are missing a top-level README entirely.
staleClaims.evidence: find packages -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d; find packages -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name README.md

staleClaims.currentTruth: The file is the default Foundry template and does not document the package's FleetCommander, Arks, DCA, rounds-vault, whitelist, or institutional contract surfaces.

The file is the default create-next-app template. It points to app/page.tsx even though this package uses src/app/page.tsx, and it describes next/font despite the app importing Geist from @fontsource.
The README is a three-line stub headed @turbo/eslint-config, while package.json names the package @summerfi/eslint-config.

staleClaims.claim: Utility contract READMEs consistently state the active license
staleClaims.currentTruth: math-utils and voting-decay READMEs claim MIT, while checked package Solidity sources use BUSL-1.1 SPDX headers. dutch-auction README also claims MIT while its active src files were already found to use BUSL-1.1 in the intent-arks audit.

staleClaims.claim: Package READMEs consistently state current runtime prerequisites
staleClaims.currentTruth: deployment and rewards-contracts READMEs still say Node.js 16+, while the repo root engines require node >=20.

unverifiable: No external package registry or deployment URLs were queried; classification is based on checked repository files only.
docs.notes: Previously audited substantive READMEs are not duplicated here: deployment, dutch-auction, gov-contracts, intent-system, summer-earn-institutions-v2-subgraph and summer-earn-rwa-app have claim-level findings in their domain groups. Utility READMEs are generally plausible for API shape (percentage/price/math/rewards/rwa-oracles), but need license/runtime cleanup and a fuller pass during README remediation.

summary: Classified every top-level packages/* README slot in summer-earn-protocol: 15 substantive READMEs, 1 stub, 2 boilerplate templates, and 32 missing READMEs. The package README surface is therefore partially-stale overall. Major remediation buckets: replace core-contracts Foundry boilerplate, replace summer-earn-rwa-app create-next boilerplate, fix eslint-config's stale @turbo package name, add READMEs for 32 missing packages, and clean up stale license/runtime claims in utility READMEs. Several substantive READMEs already have claim-level stale findings in earlier domain groups.
